# Performance (AP-PERF)

[Back to catalog](index.md)

## AP-PERF-01

**Async call per row in a template** — severity **major**, automated (scanner), principles P-10.

**Why it hurts.** Awaiting a service call inside a column or row template runs once per row per render (N+1).

**Fix.** Load the required data with the page query (projection) or in one batch call.

**Detection:** files `*.razor`; pattern `<(Template|EditTemplate|RowTemplate)\b[^>]*>(?:(?!</(Template|EditTemplate|RowTemplate)>)[\s\S]){0,600}?@\(?\s*await\b`.

## AP-PERF-02

**Search on every keystroke without debounce** — severity **minor**, automated (scanner), principles P-10.

**Why it hurts.** Calling the server on each input event floods the backend and returns results out of order.

**Fix.** Debounce (e.g. Radzen FilterDelay / a timer) and cancel the previous request.

**Detection:** files `*.razor`; pattern `@oninput\s*=\s*"[^"]*(Search|Filter|Load)\w*"`.

## AP-PERF-03

**new HttpClient()** — severity **major**, automated (scanner), principles P-02, P-10.

**Why it hurts.** Creating HttpClient per call exhausts sockets and bypasses configured handlers (auth, resilience).

**Fix.** Inject a typed client / IHttpClientFactory as the repository does.

**Detection:** files `*.razor`, `*.cs`; pattern `new\s+HttpClient\s*\(`; test files excluded.
